architecture: v4 (re-root at batch 1: whether an air navigation service provider's en-route conflict probe becomes mandatory at every planner position from 1 April 2027, read on the share of short-term conflict alert activations its use prevented in the 2026 trial, at like traffic count and like climbing and descending mix minute by minute)
slot_note: re-root of task122 in the same objective (Experiment & Causal Analysis), batch 1; biomedical-clinical-research is spent for this slot after two architectures, so the draw moves to human-factors-ergonomics (usability-task-performance-studies, which serves EC), a pairing never built; criminology was set aside because task125 drew police hot spots the same day; new world, dataset, generator and shell
niche: a New Zealand air navigation service provider's en-route control centre, where the planner controllers of six en-route sectors have run a medium-term conflict probe at their own discretion since 1 April 2026; the executive team decides in November 2026, on the Safety Review Board's acceptance criteria, whether the probe becomes mandatory at every en-route planner position from 1 April 2027, on the share of short-term conflict alert activations its use prevented
answer: mandatory at every en-route planner position from 1 April 2027; about 30 per cent of the STCA activations prevented in the probe running time
stakeholder_role: the provider's human factors lead, who puts the trial's result to the executive team, which decides whether the probe becomes mandatory at every en-route planner position from 1 April 2027 (the prompt names no one)

spine.entity: one flight's crossing of one en-route sector in one flight plan revision: callsign, aerodromes, aircraft type, entry and exit time (UTC) and level
spine.grain: flight x sector x plan revision

world.geography: New Zealand (a fictional air navigation service provider's en-route control centre; the provider, the probe trial and every record are fictional)
world.org_type: an air navigation service provider running New Zealand's en-route and approach control

driver: A discretionary aid is switched on when the conditions that produce the outcome gather, and the outcome comes almost wholly from one kind of unit present together with others, so the aid's working periods hold more of that kind than its idle periods even at the same number of units present; a comparison per unit of exposure, or at like numbers present, carries that difference into the aid's effect, while a comparison at like numbers and like mix of the two kinds, period by period, reads the aid's own effect.
driver_concrete: Compare each sector's minutes with the probe running against its minutes without, holding the number of aircraft in the sector and the number of them climbing or descending fixed, both rebuilt minute by minute from the FDPS crossings: the probe prevented about 30 per cent of the activations the sectors would have raised in its running time, where the safety report's rate per 1,000 flight hours has it doubling them and the like-occupancy comparison has it raising them by about 15 per cent.
stump: The default path prices the probe at like traffic, comparing minutes with it running against minutes without at the same number of aircraft in the sector, finds the probe's minutes raising about 15 per cent more activations, no benefit against the 20 per cent the criteria require, and keeps it discretionary; the step that lands it there is holding only the count of aircraft, when the planners switch the probe on as climbing and descending traffic gathers and almost every activation involves a climbing or descending aircraft, so at like count and like mix the probe prevented about 30 per cent and becomes mandatory.
analyst_test: A strong analyst who counts activations as the safety report counts them, takes each flight's latest plan revision, converts the planner log's local time to UTC and splits combined sectors, then compares the activation rate with the probe running against without, first per 100,000 flight hours (the safety report's measure, higher with it running) and then at like traffic, the same number of aircraft in the sector minute by minute, finds the probe's minutes raising about 15 per cent more activations, no benefit against the criteria's 20 per cent, and keeps it discretionary; every field is read and every filed rule applied, and the call is wrong because the planners switch the probe on as climbing and descending traffic gathers, which raises the activation risk at any count of aircraft.
domain_test: The deciding quantity is the share of conflict alerts a controller's decision aid prevents, a task-performance effect the field estimates by comparing the alert rate with and without the aid at matched traffic load, here only at like traffic count and like vertical mix, since conflict alerts come from pairs with a climbing or descending aircraft; with a hospital's or a retailer's nouns there is no sector traffic, no vertical mix and no conflict alert, and the task stops reading the same.
layer1: FDPS sector crossings in UTC against the planner workstation log in New Zealand local time, across the start of daylight time on 27 September 2026
combined sectors overnight, logged on the operational sector's name, against the elementary sectors of the crossings
flight plan revisions whose superseded crossings drop out of the flight's latest plan
an STCA activation that continues across a sector boundary logged once in each sector
inhibited and test activations beside live ones
activations in a combined sector attributed by the first-named aircraft's position
months counted in New Zealand time against UTC timestamps

differentiation.task121: task121 named a cause for a 911 centre's rise in handling errors, read from the rest each worker had before the shift; this build estimates a decision aid's effect on conflict alerts and its decisive step is the traffic mix the aid is switched on into, not a worker's rest.
differentiation.task131: task131 read a randomised tariff's effect on a design-day maximum where moved load returns after the window; this build has no randomisation and no rebound, and the bias is the conditions the aid is used in.
differentiation.task128: task128 read a contact's effect where the day's queue outran the team (a capacity cut as a natural experiment); this build uses no cut and no natural experiment: it conditions on the minute's traffic count and mix.
differentiation.task141: task141 priced a release rule from decision-makers' different let-through shares by rota; no decision-maker's habit carries this build, whose probe use varies by watch only as noise.
differentiation.task44: task44 carried a pilot's pooled effect onto a request whose moderator mix differs (a transport of a heterogeneous effect); this build's effect is one ratio at every traffic level and the mix confounds the comparison, not the transport.
differentiation.task69: task69 v2 re-pooled an arm contrast within periods whose assignment rate varied; this build has no designed arms, and the aid's use follows the traffic mix minute by minute.
differentiation.task170: task170 forecast data-entry errors on a learning curve per attempt; this build forecasts nothing and estimates an aid's effect at like traffic.

lineage.driver: The guardrail rate counts every outcome a candidate's exposures produce, while the log the screen is scored on records only the outcomes produced before each session closed; units under the incumbent and most candidates come back to an exposure still on screen after their session times out and act on it in a new session that the outcome record credits instead, and one candidate's units almost never do, so that candidate clears the guardrail on the log's count and fails it in one cell once the late outcomes are attributed back to the exposures that produced them, which is found only by joining each unit's later outcomes to the items its logged session showed under a rule that keeps a shown item off later exposures; a solver who nets the leader's brought-forward outcomes over the window and reads the guardrail off the log files that candidate, and the candidate fourth on the natural estimate is the largest that clears every condition.

lineage.architecture: v3 (re-root 2026-10-13 under the 10/10 rules: the phase 3 dose of a kidney drug read on the eGFR slope after the background-diuretic recovery)
lineage.driver: The long-run rate a three-year projection carries is read from the stretch after an early disturbance settles, and here part of the early fall is undone by a background change the protocol allowed only after a fixed opening period, so a long-run rate started at the field's conventional point includes that one-off recovery and carries it forward for years, crediting most the arms that fell and recovered most, while the rate taken after the recovery has run its course ranks a middle option first.
lineage.stump: A competent solver fits each dose's eGFR with the field's two-slope model, an acute effect to month 3 and a chronic slope after it, carries the chronic slope to month 36 and files 40 mg at about 5 mL/min/1.73 m2 above placebo; the step that lands it there is starting the chronic slope at month 3, when the patients whose eGFR fell most on 20 and 40 mg had their loop diuretics eased only from week 12, at the week-12, 16 and 20 visits, and recovered part of the fall over the following weeks, so a slope from month 3 carries that one-off recovery forward for three years; taken from week 24, after the recovery, the slope leaves 20 mg furthest above placebo at month 36 (3) and 40 mg at 2.

notes: Re-rooted 2026-10-31 at batch 1. Gate G decomposition_attribution: the safety report's higher activation rate in the probe's running time is a correctly reported movement, and the call assigns it to its driver, the traffic count and climbing and descending mix the planners switch the probe on into, before the probe's own share is read; the acceptance criteria's estimand (the share of the activations the sectors would have raised in the probe's running time that its use prevented) with the data's structure (probe use and activations both rising with the climbing and descending count at any occupancy) rule out the per-flight-hour and like-occupancy readings. Strategy causal_design: confounding by the conditions of use, read at the minute the aid is switched at.
